loop.top3_why_not: Candidate A, while robust to outliers, has a very high error in one validation window (0.963), indicating sensitivity to a single poor model. Candidate B, though close in score, shows higher per‑window variability and relies on a more complex DTW barycenter that may overfit to the limited validation windows. Therefore, the plain mean (C) is the safest choice for generalization.
